blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Anyone caught in rush-hour traffic knows the quiet frustration of watching a city outgrow its streets. In Butuan, an ambitious bid to untangle congested thoroughfares and protect daily commuters has carried the Agusan del Norte capital into the final round of the country’s most storied local governance awards. The initiative, dubbed Move Butuan: An Integrated Transportation and Road Safety Program, has officially secured a berth among the Top 19 national finalists of the 2026 Galing Pook Awards, emerging from an initial nationwide pool of 207 entries.
